name: redisson
description_en: Redisson: Valkey & Redis Java Client and Real-Time Data Platform. Sync/Async/RxJava/Reactive API. Over 50 Valkey and Redis based Java objects and services: Set, Multimap, SortedSet, Map, List, Queue, Deque, Semaphore, Lock, AtomicLong, Map Reduce, Bloom filter, Spring, Tomcat, Scheduler, JCache API, Hibernate, RPC, local cache..
readme_excerpt: Redisson: Valkey & Redis Java Client and Real-Time Data Platform Quick start | Documentation | Changelog | Code examples | JavaDocs Redisson is the Java Client and Real-Time Data Platform for Valkey and Redis. Redisson greatly extends the capabilities of Valkey and Redis by providing additional services and data structures not natively available in either platform.
